name: 15931 · Ebensburg, PA
findings: ZIP 15931 (Ebensburg) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (64% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15931 (Ebensburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
